passages.provision_quote: Except in a medical emergency, a physician may not intentionally or knowingly perform, induce or attempt to perform or induce an abortion if the probable gestational age of the unborn human being has been determined to be greater than fifteen weeks.
passages.note: Operative provision text of SB 1164 (2022), the gestational-limit law Bolick co-sponsored and voted for.
Bill overview lists Bolick as a co-sponsor of SB 1164 and records its passage and the governor's signature.
House Third Reading roll call records Bolick's Yea vote on SB 1164's passage, 31-26-3-0-0.

rows.reasoning: SB 1164 (2022), which Bolick co-sponsored and voted Yea for on House Third Reading (BOLICK Y, Passed 31-26-3-0-0), bars abortion after fifteen weeks gestation except in a medical emergency. That cutoff falls between "keep abortion legal through the second trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health" and "allow abortion during the first trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health," so the record shows a restrictive direction without matching either rung's specific time clause.
